# Which shares should I sell to pay the least tax?

> Free tax lot optimizer: paste your purchase lots, enter the cash you need, and get the exact shares to sell from each lot for the lowest capital-gains tax, compared with FIFO, LIFO and highest-cost-first. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
